auth_principals: Session identity and monotonic auth epoch; terminal status deleted, verified_at_ms currently retained; minimization/legal duration unresolved.
Recheck independent account denial; never reactivate from app restore.
auth_sessions: Session and CSRF token digests with expiry and revocation; bounded owner cleanup. Periodic expired-session retention still to validate.
Revalidate principal, epoch, expiry and independent deny.
auth_oauth_attempts: Unbound login state and server-only PKCE/nonce; consume once, expiry <=10 min, prune 16 at start; idle periodic prune unresolved.
Expired/replayed state must not be reusable; recovery treatment to validate.
sync_subjects: Consent generation, fence and erased-before revision; keep terminal withdrawal metadata.
Compare independent owner floor and cutoff.
sync_state: Sync revision required for terminal proof; no payload.
Restore requires current floor and revision consistency.
sync_documents: Encrypted fitness documents; bounded erasure before ADK destruction.
Never restore data below independent cutoff.
sync_replicas: Replica lease, clock and generation metadata; bounded erasure.
Fence stale replica and consent generations.
sync_receipts: Mutation acknowledgement and request digest; erase on withdrawal; pruning must preserve replay contract.
Reject stale receipts under independent cutoff.
sync_replica_mutations: Replica mutation receipt/clock; same erasure and replay constraints.
Reject stale generations under independent cutoff.
health_consent_acceptances: Version, time, adult confirmation; currently retained; legal purpose, minimization and duration not closed.
Never treat restored proof as active consent without independent floor.
health_erasure_jobs: Durable job and lease, completion evidence; retention review open.
Reconcile pending or completed generation with independent cutoff.
health_erasure_finalizations: Immutable terminal proof of removal and key disposition; retention review open.
Validate exact generation and independent cutoff.
cloud_key_issuance: Issuance timestamp only; required for never-issued/destroyed distinction; retention review open.
Do not infer recoverability from historical issuance.
cloud_account_keys: Wrapped ADK; delete atomically with terminal erasure under current lease.
Do not reissue or restore key below independent cutoff.
kinde_erasure_targets: Encrypted provider subject; retain until acknowledged Kinde deletion and readback, then terminal trigger removes.
Do not recover target from email or allow a denied owner to log in.
kinde_deletion_oauth_attempts: Five-minute owner/session-bound reauthentication state, consume once, prune at start; account cleanup removes remaining attempts.
Never redeem expired state or a stale session.
kinde_account_erasure_intents: Immutable user decision and receipt digest; retention review open.
Exact durable proof, independent deny and no fabricated reauth.
kinde_account_erasure_requests: Accepted decision/frozen epoch; retention review open.
Reconcile exact independent denial before action.
kinde_account_erasure_provider_progress: Provider lease and acknowledgement times, no plaintext subject or token; retention review open.
kinde_account_erasure_completions: Immutable account terminal proof; retention review open.
Independent deny, current terminal principal and proof required.
kinde_account_activity: Foreground observations; 12 calendar months inactivity rule; no health payload.
Old restored activity is not authority for automated erasure; validate recovery/marker before activation.
kinde_inactivity_control: Never enable on restore without explicit policy validation.
kinde_account_erasure_scheduler: Singleton traversal cursor and lease; can temporarily reference a completed owner; not a receipt, retention minimization open.
Restart/replay safely; validate owner and independent deny separately.

recovery_control: Singleton sealed/open and generation; no owner data.
recovery_owner_fences: Independent owner consent floor and fence; immutable UID, no health plaintext.
Do not roll back with application D1; fail closed if missing.
recovery_erasure_cutoffs: Independent generation cutoff and finalization marker; retain to prevent resurrection.
Verify cutoff against restored app before granting access.
recovery_account_erasure_denials: Independent owner and decision digest; permanent technical denial currently enforced, legal retention review open.
No restored application principal can bypass this denial.
